prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble. Hard film-noir chiaroscuro with the colour pushed far beyond nature: a red light on one side and cold cyan slats of light through a venetian blind on the other. Camera inside a brick bread oven looking out through its open iron door. Two American police officers in peaked caps and long blue coats, one with a walrus moustache, one with ginger sideburns, stand in a basement holding tommy guns pointed at the ceiling, peering in, puzzled; behind them gangsters in white bakers' hats stand innocently beside ovens where printing presses stood a moment ago, one with his hand still on a huge iron lever. Light: the police officers' torches; the ovens' orange glow; a red lamp over the door. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
